title: oxyceros malabaricus
intro: Oxyceros malabaricus, commonly known as the Malabar forest ruby, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the management of various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oxyceros malabaricus include its antipyretic, anti-cough, and expectorant properties, which can help in reducing fever, relieving cough, and loosening mucus in the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
